title: Concept: Flat-directory repository in the build
description: build.gradle declares a `flatDir` repository that resolves jars from a directory, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `flatDir` repository that resolves jars from a directory.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `flatDir` repository that resolves jars from a directory.
